scope.purpose: Exact-name provenance/mechanics verification and status upgrade for the next early-PQ Super Soul cluster.

evidence.use: Maintained Super Soul catalogue corroborates character identity, triggers, effects, magnitudes, durations/stacking semantics where documented, Limit Bursts, and acquisition endpoints for the five records.
Independent PQ guide corroborates the relevant early-PQ acquisition relationships.
Historical community documentation provides independent corroboration for the early Super Soul effect family represented in the selected records.

limits: No reward probability was promoted to a mechanic.
No Ultimate-Finish requirement was inferred or changed.
Exact duration remains explicitly unresolved where the canonical record already says it is not established.
